# Logitech  collaboration  technology

Discover the innovative world of Logitech

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![The New Logic of Work LIFE](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/The-New-Logic-of-Work-LIFE.png)

At Logitech, innovation starts with the user – and scales to meet the needs of the modern enterprise. From personal workstations to global collaboration, our solutions are engineered to deliver unmatched reliability, seamless integration, and effortless performance across every workspace.

## Real-Time Design with LOGITECH

Experience how to validate your Logitech room designs before you build them. No headset or specialty hardware needed!

[Schedule a VR demo](https://avispl.com/logitech/#contact)

![B2B LIFE Enhanced Productivity](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/B2B-LIFE-Enhanced-Productivity.png)

### AVI-SPL Logitech Certifications

- Logitech Principal Partner
- Video Collaboration Specialization
- Logitech Global Partner

![Logitech-TWS-Lineup-AVI-SPL](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Logitech-TWS-Lineup-AVI-SPL-1280x720-1.jpg)

### Solutions

AVI-SPL and Logitech work together to transform the way teams engage and collaborate. Logitech’s award-winning video collaboration solutions are utilized by over 70% of Fortune 500 companies, helping business unleash productivity through better collaboration – from personal workspaces to meeting rooms – with intuitive designs that work with all leading video conferencing platforms.

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/logitech/#contact)

![Rally Board 65](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Rally-Board-65-a-scaled.png)

### RALLY BOARD 65

Rally Board 65 simplifies video conferencing with an extremely easy-to-deploy, all-in-one collaboration device that combines powerful audio and video with a 65-inch touchscreen display.

- **Simple all-in-one solution** – Everything you need to quickly add video to meeting rooms and open spaces
- **Built for flexibility** – Designed for flexibility, Rally Board 65 is made for the way you meet.
- **Everyone is clearly seen and heard** – Make sure everyone is seen and heard in meeting rooms and open spaces.

##### Team Workspace

Collaboration thrives with the right tools. Logitech’s wireless solutions ensure seamless connectivity, enabling teams to work effortlessly from anywhere. With reliable, intuitive devices, your workforce stays focused, agile, and productive—wherever work takes place.

##### Personal Workspace

Logitech simplifies collaboration for the modern workplace. From essential communication tools to ergonomic setups and advanced solutions, we offer options for every workflow. Make meetings seamless and productive.

##### Education Solutions

Transform learning environments with the right technology. Logitech’s solutions enhance accessibility, reduce distractions, and foster collaboration, ensuring engaging, high-quality learning for every student, anywhere.

##### Government Workspaces

Logitech equips government agencies with secure, efficient, TAA/NDAA-compliant video tools. Enable seamless remote collaboration, reduce costs, and enhance accessibility with reliable solutions built for modern governance.

##### Mobile Workspace Solutions

Tools made for business to free employees from their desks, and give them the power to crush it – whether they are traveling, onsite, working from home or in the office. Logitech mobile solutions are easy to deploy and manage by IT.

##### Accessories

Work more efficiently, comfortably, and in style with accessories from Logitech. Logitech has solutions including presenters or accessories for iPad to solutions for video conferencing.
